info.title: Kayko EBM API
info.description: Kayko EBM third-party API gateway for RRA EBM 2.1. Authenticate with a business API key. Routes cover initialize, customers, constants, sales, purchases, stock, and more.

ApiKeyBearer.description: Kayko business API key from Settings → Enable EBM → Generate API key. Example: Bearer sk_live_…

InternalToken.name: X-API-Token

post.description: Initialize a device using TIN, branch ID, and device serial number. Returns device info and cryptographic keys (intrlKey, signKey, cmcKey). Call once before other EBM operations. Requires X-API-Token.

ebm_url.description: Business EBM base URL from Enable EBM

x-codeSamples.label: cURL
x-codeSamples.source:
curl -X POST "{{baseUrl}}/initialize/init" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-API-Token: $EBM_INTERNAL_API_TOKEN" \
  -d '{
  "tin": "122548433",
  "branch_id": "03",
  "device_serial_number": "QUA-77379",
  "ebm_url": "http://localhost:8080/rra/ACME01/"
}'

x-codeSamples.label: JavaScript
PHP
x-codeSamples.source:
<?php
$payload = json_encode([
    'tin' => '122548433',
    'branch_id' => '03',
    'device_serial_number' => 'QUA-77379',
    'ebm_url' => getenv('EBM_URL'),
]);
$ch = curl_init($baseUrl . '/initialize/init');
curl_setopt_array($ch, [
    CURLOPT_POST => true,
    CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => [
        'Content-Type: application/json',
        'X-API-Token: ' . getenv('EBM_INTERNAL_API_TOKEN'),
    ],
    CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => $payload,
    CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
]);
$result = json_decode(curl_exec($ch), true);

x-codeSamples.label: Payload
